If she’s five minutes late from the grocery store, or if she smiles at a text, my mind goes straight to her cheating. I’ve checked her phone, driven by her work on my lunch break, even gone through the credit card statements. I know it sounds extreme, but it feels absolutely real to me.

Outside of that, I still do my job. I’m at the factory every day, running the shift, dealing with the guys, making sure production targets are hit. But this thing with my wife is always in the back of my head.

A couple of times over this year, I’ve had these short bursts where I barely sleep, feel really wired, talk fast, and feel like I can handle anything at work and at home. Those “high” periods only last a few days, then I’m back to my usual self—but the belief that she’s unfaithful never really lets up.

    B. Body Dysmorphic Disorder
